pick.headline: Mujahidin leader Mojaddedi takes power in Kabul
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia front page of April 28, 1992, reported Kabul Radio and AFP on Mojaddedi arriving in Kabul amid celebratory gunfire to assume the interim presidency of the Islamic State of Afghanistan, declaring a general amnesty.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 082, 28 April 1992
evidence.snippet: FBIS-NES-92-082 28 April 1992 FRONT PAGE Afghanistan Sebghatollah Mojaddedi arrived in Kabul today amid a volley of celebratory gunfire and cries of “Allah-o-Akbar,”’according to Kabul Radio and AFP.
